summary_cn: 奥伊西（Oishi）饮料公司推出新口味绿茶「草莓之吻」，定价10泰铢，目标消费人群为年轻人和上班族。公司在泰国北部和东北地区展开密集营销，包括当地媒体宣传、体验活动和抽奖促销，致力于扩大地方市场的消费者基础。
desc_original: โออิชิ กรีนที รุกตลาดเหนือ-อีสาน ส่งชาเขียวรสใหม่ สตรอว์เบอร์รี่ คิส ราคา 10 บาท เจาะวัยรุ่น-คนทำงาน ปูพรมสื่อท้องถิ่น กิจกรรมสร้างประสบการณ์ และแคมเปญชิงโชค ขยายฐานผู้บริโภคในตลาดภูมิภาค

title: Cabinet mulls extending co-pay scheme
desc: The cabinet is set to consider extending the "Thai Chuay Thai Plus" co-payment scheme on Tuesday. Local wholesalers and retailers are backing the extension.
title_cn: 泰国内阁拟延长「泰国助泰」共付计划
summary_cn: 泰国内阁定于周二审议是否延长「泰国助泰升级版」（Thai Chuay Thai Plus）共付计划。该计划通过政府补贴帮助消费者分摊购物成本，已获得当地批发商和零售商的广泛支持。此举旨在进一步刺激国内消费，缓解消费者购物压力。
desc_original: The cabinet is set to consider extending the "Thai Chuay Thai Plus" co-payment scheme on Tuesday. Local wholesalers and retailers are backing the extension.

title: เอ็มบีเค ชู “Cave Fantasy” ดึงครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersiveจัดแพ็กเกจพิเศษ 1,399 บาท
desc: เอ็ม บี เค เซ็นเตอร์ ชวนครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersive ที่ Cave Fantasy จัด Family Package 1,399 บาท จากปกติ 1,647 บาท พร้อม Fantasy Space และ Fight Theater 4 มิติ ตลอดเดือน ก.ย.
title_cn: MBK中心推「洞穴幻想」3D沉浸式体验 家庭套票1399泰铢
summary_cn: MBK购物中心（MBK Center）推出「洞穴幻想」3D沉浸式体验馆，吸引家庭游客体验虚拟现实世界。家庭套票定价1399泰铢（较原价1647泰铢的折扣优惠），套票包含幻想空间和四维搏击影院等多个互动项目。该优惠活动贯穿整个九月，为曼谷家庭游客提供寓教于乐的室内娱乐新选择。
desc_original: เอ็ม บี เค เซ็นเตอร์ ชวนครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersive ที่ Cave Fantasy จัด Family Package 1,399 บาท จากปกติ 1,647 บาท พร้อม Fantasy Space และ Fight Theater 4 มิติ ตลอดเดือน ก.ย.

title: Postal law set for enactment by year-end
desc: The new postal law is expected to be enacted by the end of this year to address regulatory gaps and distortions in the rapidly expanding delivery and logistics market, according to Thailand Post president Dhanant Subhadrabandhu.
title_cn: 泰国新邮政法有望年底前颁布
summary_cn: 泰国邮政公司（Thailand Post）总裁达南特（Dhanant Subhadrabandhu）日前宣布，新邮政法拟在年底前正式颁布实施。该法规旨在填补现有监管空白，并纠正快速扩张的物流配送市场中的市场扭曲现象。完善的法律框架将进一步规范泰国邮政与快递行业的健康发展。
desc_original: The new postal law is expected to be enacted by the end of this year to address regulatory gaps and distortions in the rapidly expanding delivery and logistics market, according to Thailand Post president Dhanant Subhadrabandhu.

title: Larger data centres set to shift beyond Bangkok
desc: Bangkok remains Thailand's main data centre hub, but infrastructure constraints and tighter regulatory requirements could push larger projects outside the capital, according to Kasikorn Research Center.
title_cn: 大型数据中心逐步转向曼谷以外地区
summary_cn: 根据卡西空研究中心（Kasikorn Research Center）的分析，虽然曼谷目前仍为泰国主要数据中心枢纽，但基础设施约束和日益严格的监管要求可能促使大型数据中心项目逐步迁出首都。这一趋势将推动泰国数据中心产业的地域均衡分布，为地方经济发展创造新机遇。
desc_original: Bangkok remains Thailand's main data centre hub, but infrastructure constraints and tighter regulatory requirements could push larger projects outside the capital, according to Kasikorn Research Center.

title: Households face rising health costs
desc: Households are likely to bear a larger share of healthcare costs in the future, as the government will have less capacity to shoulder the burden, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).
title_cn: 家庭医疗成本面临上升压力
summary_cn: 根据泰国财务集团 Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group（KKP）的分析，随着政府财政压力增大，家庭未来将需要承担更多的医疗成本。该机构指出，政府公共医疗预算面临严峻压力，难以继续提供现有水平的补助。这意味着医疗成本增加将直接影响泰国家庭特别是中低收入群体的生活开支。
desc_original: Households are likely to bear a larger share of healthcare costs in the future, as the government will have less capacity to shoulder the burden, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).

title: Saudi attack dents Mideast market
desc: The recent attack near Riyadh Airport could further hamper Saudi Arabia and the Middle East market, which have not fully recovered from the Gulf conflict that erupted earlier this year, according to the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).
title_cn: 沙特遇袭事件打击中东旅游市场
summary_cn: 泰国旅游代理商协会（Atta）表示，利雅得（Riyadh）机场附近的遇袭事件将进一步打击沙特阿拉伯和中东市场的恢复前景。该地区目前尚未从今年早些时候爆发的海湾冲突中完全恢复，新的安全威胁将加重市场不确定性。对于依赖中东市场的泰国旅游业而言，这一事件的负面影响不容忽视。
desc_original: The recent attack near Riyadh Airport could further hamper Saudi Arabia and the Middle East market, which have not fully recovered from the Gulf conflict that erupted earlier this year, according to the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).

title: Policymakers urged to back alcohol-to-jet technology
desc: Business leaders and energy industry representatives are calling on policymakers to accelerate support for alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) technology, saying it could help reduce its reliance on imported crude oil while creating new demand for domestic agricultural products.
title_cn: 推动酒精制喷气燃料技术成为战略焦点
summary_cn: 泰国商业领袖和能源行业代表呼吁政策制定者加快推进酒精制喷气燃料（Alcohol-to-Jet, ATJ）技术的发展。这一新技术不仅有助于减少泰国对进口原油的依赖、降低能源成本，还能为国内农产品创造新的市场需求，实现能源和农业的协同发展。该举措对于泰国实现经济可持续转型具有重要的战略意义。
desc_original: Business leaders and energy industry representatives are calling on policymakers to accelerate support for alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) technology, saying it could help reduce its reliance on imported crude oil while creating new demand for domestic agricultural products.

title: AirAsia worries markets despite reassurances
desc: Analysts are expressing concern over Asia Aviation (AAV), saying higher jet fuel prices and financial strains faced by its Malaysian parent, AirAsia, could eventually affect the SET-listed low-cost carrier's operations.
title_cn: 亚洲航空股价面临多重压力
summary_cn: 市场分析人士对泰国上市航空公司亚洲航空（Asia Aviation, AAV）的前景表示担忧。国际航空燃油价格高企，加上其马来西亚母公司亚洲航空集团（AirAsia）面临的财务困难，这些负面因素最终可能波及泰国上市子公司的日常运营和财务表现。在全球航空业竞争激烈的环境中，这一系列压力值得投资者和市场关注。
desc_original: Analysts are expressing concern over Asia Aviation (AAV), saying higher jet fuel prices and financial strains faced by its Malaysian parent, AirAsia, could eventually affect the SET-listed low-cost carrier's operations.

title: Business groups urged to help bolster investment
desc: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged business groups to help drive investment in seven strategic industries as Thailand seeks to become a high-income economy within the next four years.
title_cn: 财政部长敦促商界投资七大战略产业
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长 Ekniti Nitithanprapas 呼吁商业集团积极参与投资七个战略产业，以推动泰国经济向高收入国家行列迈进，目标在未来四年内完成。这七个战略产业是泰国经济增长和产业升级的关键领域。政府通过激励商业投资，旨在实现更快速和更可持续的经济发展，反映了泰国在经济政策上的新方向。
desc_original: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged business groups to help drive investment in seven strategic industries as Thailand seeks to become a high-income economy within the next four years.

title: Stock exchange vows to continue its package of major reforms
desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) is pursuing a sweeping package of statutory and structural reforms to strengthen corporate governance, attract high-growth new economy listings and make Thai companies more attractive to investors, says SET chairman Kitipong Urapeepatanapong.
title_cn: 泰国证券交易所承诺继续推进重大改革方案
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易所(SET)主席基提蓬·乌拉佩帕塔那蓬表示，交易所正在推进包括法定和结构性改革在内的全面改革计划，旨在加强公司治理、吸引高增长新经济上市公司，并提升泰国企业在国际投资者中的吸引力。这一系列改革措施体现了交易所推动泰国资本市场健康发展的决心。
desc_original: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) is pursuing a sweeping package of statutory and structural reforms to strengthen corporate governance, attract high-growth new economy listings and make Thai companies more attractive to investors, says SET chairman Kitipong Urapeepatanapong.

title: Fuel tax cut mulled amid energy crisis
desc: The government is considering a reduction in the excise tax on fuel to ease the cost-of-living burden on the public caused by the energy crisis.
title_cn: 政府考虑削减燃油税应对能源危机
summary_cn: 在能源危机导致生活成本上升的背景下，泰国政府正在考虑降低燃油消费税，以缓解民众和企业的经济负担。燃油税削减将直接降低运输、物流成本，有助于减轻普通家庭的生活压力。这一政策调整是政府应对能源危机、稳定物价的重要举措。
desc_original: The government is considering a reduction in the excise tax on fuel to ease the cost-of-living burden on the public caused by the energy crisis.

title: PP to submit Senate vote collusion 'evidence'
desc: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut said on Monday the party would submit evidence to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) by Friday over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.
title_cn: 人民党向反腐委提交参议院选举串通「证据」
summary_cn: 人民党(PP)领导人纳塔蓬·瑞英帕尼亚武特周一宣布，该党将在本周五前向国家反腐委员会(NACC)提交证据，控告2024年参议院选举中存在串通舞弊行为。这起案件涉及泰国选举制度的公正性和民主进程，引起社会各界高度关注，将对泰国政治生态产生重要影响。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut said on Monday the party would submit evidence to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) by Friday over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

title: DSI to forward Forex-3D scam dossier to prosecutors
desc: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is expected to forward its completed case file in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud investigation to public prosecutors this week.
title_cn: 特别调查局将Forex-3D诈骗案转交检控机构
summary_cn: 泰国特别调查局(DSI)预计本周将完成Forex-3D投资诈骗案的调查，并向公诉机构提交完整案卷。该案是近年来备受瞩目的重大诈骗案件，涉及大规模非法集资和投资欺诈，受害者众多。案卷提交后，公诉机构将决定是否正式起诉相关嫌疑人。
desc_original: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is expected to forward its completed case file in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud investigation to public prosecutors this week.

title: Senators query EC after names appear in probe files
desc: A group of senators calling themselves New Breed senators have questioned the Election Commission (EC) over complaints against them after finding their names in separate investigation files.
title_cn: 参议员名单现身调查文件 质询选委会
summary_cn: 自称「新一代参议员」的一群参议员在发现自己的名字出现在独立调查文件中后，向选举委员会(EC)提出质询。这些参议员要求委员会解释针对他们的投诉内容并说明调查进展，反映了围绕参议院合规性和选举程序的持续政治争议，体现了参议院内部的权力制衡。
desc_original: A group of senators calling themselves New Breed senators have questioned the Election Commission (EC) over complaints against them after finding their names in separate investigation files.

title: Air hostess heroin case advances
desc: The Office of the Attorney-General (OAG) has ordered the indictment of four suspects allegedly linked to a transnational drug trafficking network involving Thai Airways flight attendant Meena Kondo in a heroin smuggling case.
title_cn: 泰航空姐毒品案进展，律政署下令起诉四名嫌疑人
summary_cn: 泰国律政署下令起诉四名嫌疑人，他们涉嫌参与一个跨国毒品贩运网络。案件涉及泰国航空公司空姐Meena Kondo走私海洛因。此案反映了国际毒品走私网络的活跃，可能对机场安全和国际旅客造成影响。
desc_original: The Office of the Attorney-General (OAG) has ordered the indictment of four suspects allegedly linked to a transnational drug trafficking network involving Thai Airways flight attendant Meena Kondo in a heroin smuggling case.

title: PM eyes stronger Japan ties
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday urged Thailand and Japan to move from producing goods for one another to producing them together, saying closer supply-chain ties would help sustain Japanese investment as the automotive industry shifts towards electric vehicles.
title_cn: 泰国总理促深化泰日经济合作，共同应对电动车转型
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷周一呼吁泰日两国从各自生产转向联合制造，认为深化供应链合作能维持日本在电动汽车时代的投资。这一举措旨在强化两国经贸关系，应对全球汽车产业转型。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday urged Thailand and Japan to move from producing goods for one another to producing them together, saying closer supply-chain ties would help sustain Japanese investment as the automotive industry shifts towards electric vehicles.

title: Seniors urged to use traditional Chinese medicine  to slow cognitive decline
desc: Older people are being encouraged to adopt four daily practices based on traditional Chinese medicine to help maintain brain health and slow cognitive decline.
title_cn: 老年人宜采用中医疗法缓解认知功能衰退
summary_cn: 卫生部门鼓励老年人采用四项基于中医理论的日常保健方法，以维持脑部健康、缓减认知衰退。这些传统养生实践被认为有助于改善老年人的脑健康。
desc_original: Older people are being encouraged to adopt four daily practices based on traditional Chinese medicine to help maintain brain health and slow cognitive decline.

title: Govt racing to conclude US tariff negotiations
desc: Thailand is seeking to conclude trade negotiations with the United States before Washington announces the results of investigations into Thai trade practices that could lead to additional tariffs, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.
title_cn: 泰国加紧美国关税谈判，力争在调查公布前达成协议
summary_cn: 泰国商业副总理兼商务部长素帕杰表示，泰国正力争在美国宣布对泰国贸易行为调查结果前达成贸易协议，以避免面临额外关税。这反映了美泰贸易谈判的紧迫性和复杂性。
desc_original: Thailand is seeking to conclude trade negotiations with the United States before Washington announces the results of investigations into Thai trade practices that could lead to additional tariffs, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.

title: Anutin says cabinet has no ties to grey businesses
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul insisted on Monday that no member of his cabinet has ties to grey or illicit businesses and that his government has no reason to compromise with anyone involved in illegal activities.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷否认内阁与灰色产业有关联
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷周一强调，其内阁成员与灰色或非法业务没有任何关联，政府无需与涉及非法活动的人士妥协。此言论旨在回应对政府廉洁性的质疑。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul insisted on Monday that no member of his cabinet has ties to grey or illicit businesses and that his government has no reason to compromise with anyone involved in illegal activities.

title: Farmers oppose seed changes
desc: Farmer groups and their civil society allies will gather at the Agriculture Ministry on Wednesday to oppose draft legal changes that would align Thailand with an international convention granting plant breeders stronger intellectual property rights over new seed varieties.
title_cn: 农民反对种子改革法案
summary_cn: 泰国农民团体及民间组织将于周三在农业部集会，反对政府拟议的法律改革草案。该草案旨在使泰国与国际公约接轨，强化植物育种者对新品种种子的知识产权保护。农民担忧此举将提高种子采购成本，限制农民的育种自主权。
desc_original: Farmer groups and their civil society allies will gather at the Agriculture Ministry on Wednesday to oppose draft legal changes that would align Thailand with an international convention granting plant breeders stronger intellectual property rights over new seed varieties.

title: Thailand tourist arrivals top 22m as Malaysia, Japan surge
desc: Thailand tourist arrivals top 22m as Malaysia, Japan surge Legacy Thailand tourist arrivals have passed 22.18 million so far this year, while the latest weekly figures improved as holiday travel from Malaysia and Japan gave short-haul markets a lift ahead of the October high season. Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said yesterday, September 21, that Thailand welcomed 22,183,678 foreign visitors between January 1 and September 19. The total was still 3.67% lower than during the same period last yea r, while foreign tourism revenue reached 1.082821 trillion baht. China remained Thailand’s largest source market with 3,728,585 visitors, followed by Malaysia with 2,831,654 and India with 1,640,441. Russia ranked fourth with 1,230,256 arrivals, while South Korea contributed 811,246. The latest week showed a stronger picture as Thailand recorded 464,200 foreign arrivals from September 13 to 19, an increase of 25,131 visitors, or 5.72%, from the previous week. That worked out to an average of 66,314 arrivals per day. Short-haul markets accounted for 324,816 visitors, rising 8.59% week on week, while long-haul arrivals slipped 0.41% to 139,384. title: Thai King’s son wants to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery
desc: Thai King’s son wants to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery Legacy Dr Chakriwat “Than Aong” Vivacharawongse, a son of Thailand’s King Maha Vajiralongkorn, has spoken publicly about his wish to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery. In a video posted overnight, Dr Chakriwat said he has two large brain tumours requiring surgery. He wants to receive treatment in Thailand because he believes Thai doctors have the necessary expertise. He said he does not have enough money to undergo the operation in Malaysia or the United States. He also fears he could die if he does not receive proper treatment in time. “I want to return to Thailand for treatment because Thai doctors are highly capable,” he said in the video, according to his account of the situation. The appeal provides new details about the medical emergency he disclosed on September 18. At the time, the 43-year-old physician said his health was in a “truly terrible condition” and that several neurologists had warned he could become bedridden or lose his life if treatment were delayed. title: Chon Buri flags 14,264 firms with foreign shareholders for nominee checks
desc: Chon Buri flags 14,264 firms with foreign shareholders for nominee checks Legacy Seventy companies were picked for detailed checks and 39 were rated high risk. Sixteen gave no explanation, and all the cases are now with the Department of Special Investigation. Chon Buri has identified 14,264 companies with foreign shareholders or co-investors as needing risk monitoring. Officials say the review is looking for firms that use Thai nominees or hold land illegally. The figures were presented to a House foreign affairs committee at Pattaya City Hall on Friday, September 18. Officials stressed that foreign shareholding was not in itself illegal. The provincial commerce chief, Hathairat Keerival, said 70 companies were selected for detailed inspection in the first phase. Fifty-four submitted explanations and 16 did not. A risk assessment put 39 of the 70 in the high-risk group and 31 in the low-risk group. All the cases are now under investigation by the DSI, Hathairat said. In Banglamung district alone, 350 companies with foreign ownership hold land. That figure came from Chaiporn Prasertsiri of the Banglamung branch of the Chon Buri Land Office. title: 3 Thai women held at Sri Lanka airport with nearly 8kg of cannabis
desc: 3 Thai women held at Sri Lanka airport with nearly 8kg of cannabis Legacy Three Thai women were arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport in Katunayake, Sri Lanka , after almost eight kilogrammes of cannabis were found hidden in their luggage. The Airport Police Narcotics Bureau announced the arrests on Sunday, September 20. According to Sri Lankan authorities, the three women had travelled from Bangkok on the same Thai Airways flight, TG307, which landed at about 12.50am. Police reportedly found the drugs hidden inside their luggage, with the packages disguised as nutritional supplements, collagen products and bars of soap. The arrests were made during two separate operations. In the first operation, a 38 year old Thai woman was allegedly found carrying 3.22 kilogrammes of cannabis and 1.85 kilogrammes of hashish. Photo by Nednapa via Getty Images In the second operation, a 31 year old Thai woman was allegedly found with 1.99 kilogrammes of Kush and 620 grammes of hashish. Another Thai woman, aged 36, who travelled on the same flight, was also arrested on suspicion of assisting with cannabis trafficking. title: Thailand weighs minimum delivery rider pay, platform pushes back
desc: Thailand weighs minimum delivery rider pay, platform pushes back Legacy Thailand is moving towards a minimum compensation framework for app-based delivery riders , with officials looking beyond an ongoing dispute involving Lalamove to develop rules that could eventually apply more broadly across digital platforms. Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob said the ministry is collecting information on rider costs and payment rates to develop a minimum-rate formula. Rather than relying only on data from Lalamove and its riders, officials plan to expand the study to other platforms and groups of workers before deciding what an appropriate benchmark should look like. The work could eventually feed into legislation covering platform workers, a group that currently does not have a specific law directly regulating compensation in this area. desc: อึ้ง! 7 เดือนแรกปีนี้ ไทยนำเข้าแผงโซลาร์เซลล์ทะลุ 1.4 หมื่นล้านบาท พุ่ง 88.7% จีนครองแชมป์เกือบทั้งหมด รับความต้องการลดค่าไฟ หนุนโซลาร์รูฟท็อปภาคประชาชนตามนโยบายรัฐ

summary_cn: 今年前7个月，泰国太阳能电池板进口额激增88.7%，突破140亿泰铢，中国产品占绝对优势。增长动力来自全民降电费需求和政府鼓励私人屋顶太阳能推广政策，推动家庭和企业广泛安装光伏系统。

desc: “เซ็นทรัล” ทุ่มลงทุนเวียดนามรอบใหม่ 3,500 ล้านดอลลาร์ CRC รับ 1,500 ล้านดอลลาร์ใน 3-5 ปี ลุย 200 ทำเล คัดเหลือ 50-70 แห่ง ขยายเมืองรอง ไม่ลงร้านเล็กถี่ๆ แบบเจ้าถิ่น
title_cn: 中央百货越南扩张计划 35亿美元投资3-5年开业50-70家门店
summary_cn: 泰国中央百货集团(Central)新一轮越南投资额35亿美元，其中CRC获投15亿美元。集团从200个候选地点筛选至50-70家门店，专注二三线城市扩张，避免重复密集开店，预期在3-5年内完成部署。

title: MRT สายสีน้ำเงิน-สายสีม่วง แจ้งเปิดให้บริการตามปกติทุกสถานีแล้ว
desc: รถไฟฟ้า MRT สายสีน้ำเงิน-สายสีม่วง แจ้งเปิดให้บริการตามปกติทุกสถานี หลังเกิดเหตุเพลิงไหม้บริเวณแนวทางรถไฟ
title_cn: MRT 蓝线、紫线全线恢复正常运营
summary_cn: 曼谷地铁MRT蓝线与紫线因铁路沿线火灾事故中断服务，已恢复全线正常运营。这两条线路是曼谷主要公共交通动脉，日均客流量庞大，任何中断都会严重影响市民出行。火灾应急处置已完毕，安全检查通过，乘客可安心乘坐。MRT将持续监控线路状况，确保后续运营安全平稳。

title: NISSAN ย้ำ  ไปต่อ ไม่ต้องรอชาร์จ ปล่อยโฆษณาใหม่ ชูจุดขาย e-POWER
desc: Nissan Thailand เดินหน้าต่อยอดแคมเปญ ทุกนาทีมีค่า ส่งโฆษณาชุดใหม่ ชีวิตไปต่อ ไม่ต้องรอชาร์จ ชวนปรับมุมมองจากการเสียเวลาจอดรอชาร์จไฟ ไปสู่การเพิ่มเวลาใช้ชีวิตอย่างคุ้มค่า
title_cn: 日产(NISSAN)推出新广告宣传e-POWER混动技术
summary_cn: 日产泰国公司推出新一轮广告宣传，主题为「生活继续，无需等待充电」，着重宣传e-POWER混动技术的实用优势。广告旨在改变消费者对电动车充电耗时的认知，强调e-POWER技术能有效减少充电等待时间，让用户获得更多宝贵的生活时间。此举反映日产在泰国市场的战略调整，致力于推广更贴近消费者需求的新能源解决方案。

title_cn: 2026年9月21日泰国油价最新报价
summary_cn: 泰国今日油价更新发布，涵盖汽油、汽油-柴油混合燃料、柴油等全类型燃料。报价来自多家主要加油站：泰国石油公司(PTT)、中部石油(Bangchak)、石油公司(PT)、卡尔特克斯(Caltex)、赛斯科(Susco)及壳牌(Shell)等。油价波动直接影响泰国消费品物价与交通成本，与在泰居民和游客的日常生活支出密切相关。
desc_original: อัปเดตราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 21 กันยายน 2569 เช็กราคาน้ำมันทุกชนิด กลุ่มเบนซิน, แก๊สโซฮอล์, ดีเซล จากปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท., บางจาก, พีที, คาลเท็กซ์, ซัสโก้ และเชลล์ ล่าสุดราคาลิตรละกี่บาทแล้ว

title: Day of reckoning for rival tech schools
desc: Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-Ok's Uthenthawai Campus and the Pathumwan Institute of Technology (PIT), two of Bangkok's oldest technical institutions, were ordered on Sept 9 to suspend on-site teaching for at least three months.
title_cn: 曼谷两所技术学院被下令停止校内教学
summary_cn: 曼谷历史悠久的泰国国家技术大学(Rajamangala University of Technology)Tawan-Ok校Uthenthawai分校与帕通万技术学院(PIT)于9月9日被下令停止校内教学至少三个月。这两所机构是曼谷重要的职业教育基地，教学禁令影响大量学生的学业进程。此项行政处分涉及教学质量、管理规范或安全等问题，反映泰国教育部门的监管更新。
desc_original: Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-Ok's Uthenthawai Campus and the Pathumwan Institute of Technology (PIT), two of Bangkok's oldest technical institutions, were ordered on Sept 9 to suspend on-site teaching for at least three months.

title: ทีพีซีประกาศลั่น!ปรับทัพธุรกิจครั้งใหญ่  โชว์รายได้ทะยาน 4 พันล้าน
desc: ทีพีซีเล็งคลอดโปรดักต์ใหม่ จ่อชงเรื่องเข้าครม.เปิดทางขายคนไทย ไลฟ์สไตล์พรีเมียม ลดพึ่งพารายได้วีซ่าต่างชาติ มั่นใจปีงบประมาณ 2569 กวาดรายได้ทุบสถิติ 4,000 ล้านบาท
title_cn: TPC宣布大规模业务重组，目标营收40亿泰铢
summary_cn: TPC公司宣布推出新产品，计划向政府内阁提案，以拓展面向泰国消费者的高端生活方式产品线。该公司目标是减少对外国游客签证收入的依赖，实现收入来源多元化。根据计划，在2569财政年度(2026年10月至2027年9月)，TPC有信心实现40亿泰铢的营收目标，创造历史新高，体现其商业模式的重大战略调整。
desc_original: ทีพีซีเล็งคลอดโปรดักต์ใหม่ จ่อชงเรื่องเข้าครม.เปิดทางขายคนไทย ไลฟ์สไตล์พรีเมียม ลดพึ่งพารายได้วีซ่าต่างชาติ มั่นใจปีงบประมาณ 2569 กวาดรายได้ทุบสถิติ 4,000 ล้านบาท

title: กลุ่ม TCP ดันซอฟต์พาวเวอร์ไทย สร้างแพลตฟอร์มบันเทิงเจาะตลาดจีน
desc: กลุ่มธุรกิจ TCP เดินหน้าปั้นแบรนด์ เรดบูล ในจีน ใช้ดนตรี ศิลปะ อาหาร และวัฒนธรรมไทยเชื่อมผู้บริโภค พร้อมดันศิลปินและอุตสาหกรรมสร้างสรรค์ไทย ผ่าน Very Thai Music Festival 2026 ที่หูโจว
title_cn: TCP集团力推泰国软实力 打造娱乐平台开拓中国市场
summary_cn: TCP集团通过音乐、艺术、美食及泰国文化元素，在中国推广Red Bull品牌。该集团将在杭州举办Very Thai Music Festival 2026，进一步推广泰国艺人和创意产业，深化中泰文化交流与商业合作。
desc_original: กลุ่มธุรกิจ TCP เดินหน้าปั้นแบรนด์ เรดบูล ในจีน ใช้ดนตรี ศิลปะ อาหาร และวัฒนธรรมไทยเชื่อมผู้บริโภค พร้อมดันศิลปินและอุตสาหกรรมสร้างสรรค์ไทย ผ่าน Very Thai Music Festival 2026 ที่หูโจว

title: Media explores AI opportunities, risks
desc: The Thai Journalists Association (TJA) and the Lao Journalists Association (LJA) have reaffirmed their partnership, highlighting both the opportunities and risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) in regional reporting.
title_cn: 泰老媒体探讨AI机遇与风险
summary_cn: 泰国记者协会与老挝记者协会重申合作伙伴关系，共同探讨人工智能在地区新闻报道中带来的机遇和风险，推进东南亚媒体协作应对AI时代挑战。
desc_original: The Thai Journalists Association (TJA) and the Lao Journalists Association (LJA) have reaffirmed their partnership, highlighting both the opportunities and risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) in regional reporting.

title: Krungsri event celebrates sustainable transition efforts
desc: Bank of Ayudhya Plc (Krungsri), Thailand's fifth-largest financial group by assets, loans and deposits, and one of the country's six domestic systemically important banks, is turning transition plans into action, strengthening its business network and supporting sustainable growth.
title_cn: 大城银行推进可持续转型 强化业务网络
summary_cn: 泰国资产排名第五的金融集团大城银行（Krungsri），作为六家系统重要银行之一，将可持续发展转型计划付诸实施，加强业务网络建设，支持经济可持续增长。
desc_original: Bank of Ayudhya Plc (Krungsri), Thailand's fifth-largest financial group by assets, loans and deposits, and one of the country's six domestic systemically important banks, is turning transition plans into action, strengthening its business network and supporting sustainable growth.

title: Nurturing Thailand's screen talent
desc: Moving Thailand's film and series industry forward requires comprehensive support and improvements across the spectrum, including education, sufficient development time and funding, according to Nottapon Boonprakob, the renowned Thai film and series director and screenwriter.
title_cn: 培育泰国影视产业人才刻不容缓
summary_cn: 著名泰国电影及剧集导演兼编剧Nottapon Boonprakob指出，推动泰国影视产业发展需在教育、制作周期和融资等多环节提供全面支持，才能培育更多优秀产业人才。
desc_original: Moving Thailand's film and series industry forward requires comprehensive support and improvements across the spectrum, including education, sufficient development time and funding, according to Nottapon Boonprakob, the renowned Thai film and series director and screenwriter.

title: Thai brokerages could crater as new players compete
desc: Thailand's brokerage industry could undergo major consolidation amid intensified competition, with the number of securities firms potentially falling by half to around 15, says Kitipong Urapeepatanapong, chairman of the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
title_cn: 泰国证券经纪业面临剧变 竞争加剧触发行业整合
summary_cn: 泰国证交所主席Kitipong Urapeepatanapong警示，证券经纪业竞争加剧、新玩家涌入，可能引发行业大规模整合，证券公司数量有望从现在的30家左右下降至约15家。
desc_original: Thailand's brokerage industry could undergo major consolidation amid intensified competition, with the number of securities firms potentially falling by half to around 15, says Kitipong Urapeepatanapong, chairman of the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

title: US tariff deal  'taking shape'
desc: Thailand has secured its desired tariff rate it sought from the United States but one additional condition raised by Washington remains to be finalised, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Sunday.
title_cn: 美国关税协议「初步成型」
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷表示，泰国已获得美国同意的理想关税税率，但华盛顿提出的一项额外条件仍需敲定。这项协议涉及两国贸易关系，将影响相关产业的进口成本与竞争力。
desc_original: Thailand has secured its desired tariff rate it sought from the United States but one additional condition raised by Washington remains to be finalised, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Sunday.

title: PM vows no special treatment
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has vowed not to protect anyone suspected of fraud in local government recruitment exams, saying he is awaiting further details before deciding whether further action is needed.
title_cn: 总理誓言不徇私情
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷承诺不会庇护任何在地方政府招聘考试中涉嫌舞弊的人员，表示正在等待更多细节以决定是否采取进一步行动，体现廉政立场。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has vowed not to protect anyone suspected of fraud in local government recruitment exams, saying he is awaiting further details before deciding whether further action is needed.

title: Most 'unfazed' by Senate case: poll
desc: More than half of respondents to a Nida Poll survey are not worried that the Election Commission's decision to prosecute 77 people, including 26 sitting senators, over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election will cause political unrest.
title_cn: 民调：多数民众对参议院案件「不以为然」
summary_cn: 尼达民调显示，超过半数受访者不担心选举委员会起诉77人（其中26名现任参议员）涉嫌2024年参议院选举串通舞弊一案会引发政治动荡，反映出公众对此事件的关注度相对有限。
desc_original: More than half of respondents to a Nida Poll survey are not worried that the Election Commission's decision to prosecute 77 people, including 26 sitting senators, over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election will cause political unrest.

title: Ministry makes headway on driver pay
desc: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry has made progress in developing a framework for calculating a minimum payment rate for drivers in on-demand ride-hailing and parcel delivery services.
title_cn: 数字经济部推进司机薪酬框架
summary_cn: 泰国数字经济和社会部在制定网约车和快递配送司机最低报酬率计算框架方面取得进展，旨在保护从业者权益、规范新兴移动平台的劳资标准。
desc_original: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry has made progress in developing a framework for calculating a minimum payment rate for drivers in on-demand ride-hailing and parcel delivery services.

title: AI growth with guardrails
desc: The growing global debate about whether to slow artificial intelligence (AI) development to address its potential dangers should be a wake-up call for Thailand to step up its cyberdefence and human oversight as the country pursues AI-driven growth.
title_cn: 人工智能增长需设防护栏
summary_cn: 全球对减缓人工智能发展潜在风险的争议日益增多，泰国应以此为警示，在追求 AI 驱动增长的同时加强网络防御和人工监督机制，防范风险。
desc_original: The growing global debate about whether to slow artificial intelligence (AI) development to address its potential dangers should be a wake-up call for Thailand to step up its cyberdefence and human oversight as the country pursues AI-driven growth.

title: FTI advisor urges balanced use of AI
desc: People should make smart and balanced use of artificial intelligence (AI) to avoid becoming overly dependent on the technology and developing a "rusty brain", despite its growing importance in manufacturing and business operations, according to Supant Mongkolsuthree, honorary chairman of the Federation of Thai Industries.
title_cn: 泰国工业联合会顾问呼吁平衡使用人工智能
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会(Federation of Thai Industries)荣誉主席呼吁民众智慧平衡地使用人工智能(AI)，避免过度依赖导致「大脑生锈」。虽然AI在制造业和商业运营中作用日益重要，但盲目依赖可能带来消极影响，需在技术便利和保持独立思考间找到平衡。
desc_original: People should make smart and balanced use of artificial intelligence (AI) to avoid becoming overly dependent on the technology and developing a "rusty brain", despite its growing importance in manufacturing and business operations, according to Supant Mongkolsuthree, honorary chairman of the Federation of Thai Industries.

title: Townsend hit by pitch roller
desc: The Football Association of Thailand has spoken out after Andros Townsend, the 35-year-old former England international forward of PT Prachuap FC, was struck by a pitch roller while warming up with his teammates during half-time in their match against Pattani FC.
title_cn: 英援陶森森赛中被草坪滚筒击伤
summary_cn: 泰超普拉查普足球俱乐部英籍前锋安德鲁斯·陶森森(Andros Townsend)，35岁前英格兰国脚，在对阵帕坦FC(Pattani FC)的比赛中场休息期间热身时被草坪滚筒击中受伤。泰国足协已就此安全事故作出回应，引发对赛场防卫工作的关注。
desc_original: The Football Association of Thailand has spoken out after Andros Townsend, the 35-year-old former England international forward of PT Prachuap FC, was struck by a pitch roller while warming up with his teammates during half-time in their match against Pattani FC.

title: Four suspects sought over deadly Narathiwat attack
desc: Authorities are hunting for four suspected leaders of a group blamed for a disturbance in Narathiwat's Sukhirin district on Friday that left two territorial defence volunteers dead and 16 injured.
title_cn: 陶公府苏基林县暴力事件四嫌犯在逃
summary_cn: 当局正缉捕四名嫌疑人，他们被指为陶公府(Narathiwat)苏基林县(Sukhirin)周五暴力事件的幕后策划者。该事件造成两名领土防卫志愿者死亡、16人受伤。此案暴露该区域安全隐患，引发当地防卫和执法部门高度关注。
desc_original: Authorities are hunting for four suspected leaders of a group blamed for a disturbance in Narathiwat's Sukhirin district on Friday that left two territorial defence volunteers dead and 16 injured.

title: Central Plain provinces on flood watch
desc: The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) has stepped up monitoring of the Chao Phraya River as water levels are expected to rise over the next week, particularly in low-lying areas outside flood barriers in Ayutthaya.
title_cn: 泰国中部平原各府进入防洪警戒
summary_cn: 泰国灾害防止和减灾部门(DDPM)加强了对湄南河(Chao Phraya River)的监测，预计未来一周水位将上升。大城府(Ayutthaya)防洪堤外的低洼地区面临洪涝风险最高，有关部门已启动防灾预案，提醒民众及时准备。
desc_original: The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) has stepped up monitoring of the Chao Phraya River as water levels are expected to rise over the next week, particularly in low-lying areas outside flood barriers in Ayutthaya.

title: Trust builds up content creator market
desc: Thailand's creator market is projected to reach 60 billion baht by 2027 as brands prioritise credibility and sales over follower counts, while tighter regulation and artificial intelligence (AI) reshape competition.
title_cn: 信任驱动泰国内容创作市场增长
summary_cn: 泰国内容创作市场预计到2027年达到600亿泰铢规模。品牌越来越重视创作者可信度和实际销售转化，而非单纯粉丝数量。与此同时，更严格的行业监管和人工智能(AI)技术应用正在深刻重塑市场竞争格局。
desc_original: Thailand's creator market is projected to reach 60 billion baht by 2027 as brands prioritise credibility and sales over follower counts, while tighter regulation and artificial intelligence (AI) reshape competition.

title: Border trade up nearly 23% in July
desc: Thailand's border trade rose nearly 23% year-on-year in July, but trade with Cambodia remains subdued because of tensions.
title_cn: 泰国边境贸易7月增长近23%
summary_cn: 泰国7月边境贸易同比增长近23%，创出令人瞩目的佳绩。但受地区政治紧张局势影响，泰国与柬埔寨间的贸易仍陷入低迷，增长动力受制约，两国经济关系有待改善。
desc_original: Thailand's border trade rose nearly 23% year-on-year in July, but trade with Cambodia remains subdued because of tensions.

title: NT to mull extension  of Thaicom 4 satellite
desc: National Telecom (NT) is expected to evaluate a joint proposal from Thaicom Plc and an Indian state enterprise within this month to extend the operation of the Thaicom 4 satellite by three months, despite concerns about the satellite's engineering and an ongoing deadlock at the regulator.
title_cn: 国家电信考虑延长Thaicom 4卫星运营期限
summary_cn: 国家电信(NT)预计本月内评估泰国通信卫星公司(Thaicom)与印度国企的联合提案，拟延长Thaicom 4卫星运营三个月。尽管该提案有望推进国家通信基础设施建设，但卫星工程状况仍有隐忧，监管部门目前陷入僵局，为项目审批增添不确定性。
desc_original: National Telecom (NT) is expected to evaluate a joint proposal from Thaicom Plc and an Indian state enterprise within this month to extend the operation of the Thaicom 4 satellite by three months, despite concerns about the satellite's engineering and an ongoing deadlock at the regulator.

title: GPF keeps  its eye on  the prize
desc: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) is focusing on downside risk, portfolio resilience and transition opportunities as climate change, artificial intelligence (AI) and demographic shifts reshape the investment landscape.

desc_original: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) is focusing on downside risk, portfolio resilience and transition opportunities as climate change, artificial intelligence (AI) and demographic shifts reshape the investment landscape.

desc: Trains running on the Blue Line of Bangkok's fire-damaged Mass Rapid Transit system would resume full services on Monday morning if overnight repairs were complete and guaranteed safe,  Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said on Sunday.

title: Poll finds 67% have little faith in Thai justice system
desc: Poll finds 67% have little faith in Thai justice system Legacy A majority of respondents in a new Suan Dusit Poll expressed low confidence in the fairness and impartiality of Thailand’s justice system following recent political cases. The survey, released today, September 20, was conducted by Suan Dusit Poll at Suan Dusit University among 1,123 respondents nationwide between September 15 and 18. Responses were collected both online and in the field. Asked how much confidence they had in the fairness and neutrality of the Thai justice system in light of recent political cases, 46.39% said they were not very confident, while 21.10% said they had no confidence at all. Taken together, 67.49% expressed little or no confidence. By comparison, 18.52% said they were fairly confident and 7.67% said they had a high level of confidence, while 6.32% were unsure or had no opinion. Photo via Magnific Respondents were also asked whether different groups in Thai society receive equal treatment from the justice system. title: Fire at Tao Poon MRT station disrupts Blue Line services
desc: Fire at Tao Poon MRT station disrupts Blue Line services Legacy Passengers were evacuated from Tao Poon MRT station in Bangkok after an electrical fire broke out on the tracks today, September 20, forcing a temporary service suspension and causing delays. The Rama 9 radio centre received the first report at around 12.20pm after a fire was reported on the rail area near Tao Poon station on Pracharat Sai 2 Road in Bang Sue. Bang Pho firefighters arrived shortly afterwards and found flames around electrical equipment on the tracks. By 12.43pm, crews had entered the station’s electrical control area with thermal imaging equipment and smoke extractors. All passengers had been evacuated, and no injuries were reported. Photo via Fire & Rescue Thailand Bangkok Expressway and Metro Public Company Limited (BEM) said an electrical system fault forced MRT services to be suspended between Bang O and Kamphaeng Phet stations, with passengers advised to use nearby stations. Some stations experienced delays of around 60 minutes. Sparks from the fire also fell to street level, causing minor damage to one parked motorcycle. title: Four jailed for 23 years after 24 Thai women forced into London brothels
desc: Four jailed for 23 years after 24 Thai women forced into London brothels Legacy Four people have been jailed in London over a trafficking network that brought Thai women to Britain and forced them to work in brothels , the Metropolitan Police said. Woolwich Crown Court handed down the sentences on Friday, September 18, totalling nearly 23 years. Detectives identified 24 women they believe were exploited by the group. All arrived last year, mostly on what appeared to be ordinary visitor visas. Police said the women were told they owed tens of thousands of pounds and had their passports taken, leaving many isolated and dependent on their exploiters. They were then taken to brothels in London and Kent and pressed to work off the debts. One woman was smuggled in from the Netherlands, hidden in the back of a vehicle after crossing the Channel. The case began last year when officers carrying out welfare checks at brothels linked to a separate inquiry spoke to Thai women. They said a woman they knew as Freya, or Freya Ice Queen, had taken their passports. That led detectives to a wider group controlling brothels across London and Kent. title: Yala attacks leave village official dead and vehicles burned
desc: Yala attacks leave village official dead and vehicles burned Legacy An assistant village headman was shot dead, and several attacks hit Yala overnight, prompting the provincial governor to order an immediate increase in security . The violence occurred across Bannang Sata district from late yesterday, September 19, into the early hours of today. The first incident involved the fatal shooting of 42 year old Hamdi Jesoh, an assistant village headman. Hamdi was riding a motorcycle to visit his wife when unidentified attackers ambushed and shot him with a shotgun , killing him. Photo via DailyNews At around 2.30am, further attacks were reported at several points along Highway 410 in Ban Phong Yamu. Attackers burned tyres, placed a suspicious object on the road, scattered road spikes and destroyed two CCTV cameras. Three construction vehicles belonging to a contractor working on a four-lane road project were also set on fire, including an excavator and road rollers. A resident’s car was also burned while its owner was returning from Betong district. Photo via DailyNews Bannang Sata police, military personnel, administrative officials and forensic officers examined the scene this morning

Three construction vehicles belonging to a contractor working on a four-lane road project were also set on fire, including an excavator and road rollers. A resident’s car was also burned while its owner was returning from Betong district. Photo via DailyNews Bannang Sata police, military personnel, administrative officials and forensic officers examined the scene this morning

title: Woman gives birth beside dinosaur display outside Pattaya mall
desc: Woman gives birth beside dinosaur display outside Pattaya mall Legacy A woman gave birth unexpectedly outside a Pattaya shopping centre, where a newborn girl was found beside a dinosaur display before rescuers located the exhausted mother inside the mall . The Sawang Boriboon rescue foundation was alerted on September 19 to the newborn outside Central Beach Festival on Pattaya Second Road. Rescuers found the baby lying near fencing around a dinosaur display with the umbilical cord still attached . She was initially silent but began crying after responders moved in to help. Photo via Siam Chon News Motorcycle taxi drivers nearby brought cloth to cover the baby and held her while emergency services were contacted. The mother, a 40 year old woman from Bangkok, was initially nowhere to be found. Mall security and rescue workers searched the area before locating her exhausted in a ground-floor toilet. Rescuers said the placenta had been discarded in a bin. Photo via Siam Chon News The woman and her baby were then taken to Pattaya Hospital. Initial examinations found both were safe but required close observation. The mother was suffering from heavy bleeding and severe exhaustion, reporte

summary_cn: 9月19日，一名40岁曼谷女性在芭提雅中央海滨节庆购物中心外意外分娩。新生女婴被发现躺在恐龙展示栏杆旁，脐带仍连接。附近摩托出租车司机提供协助。母亲随后在购物中心一楼洗手间被发现，已极度虚弱并大量出血。母婴均被送往芭提雅医院观察，目前安全无虞。

title: Uthai Thani official denies raping minor, claims relationship was consensual
desc: Uthai Thani official denies raping minor, claims relationship was consensual Legacy A local official in Uthai Thani has been charged with raping a girl aged 15 or younger, but denied the allegation and claimed his relationship with the autistic woman had been consensual . The case involves “Ae”, now 20, whose family alleges the official repeatedly raped her from primary school age until she became pregnant at around 15, threatened her family and later raped her again. Her family returned to the police on September 18 with medical evidence and called for the case to be prosecuted. The 65 year old deputy chief of a subdistrict administrative organisation in Lan Sak district appeared at Lan Sak Police Station the same day to meet investigators. Officers checked whether he was carrying any weapons before taking him into an interview room, following allegations from Ae’s family that he had previously claimed to possess guns and had threatened them. Photo via DailyNews Speaking to reporters, the official denied raping Ae but acknowledged having had a relationship with her when she was around 15 to 16 years old. He claimed the relationship was consensual and referred to her as his wife. H

summary_cn: 乌泰他尼兰沙区副区长因强奸未成年少女被控诉。受害人艾现年20岁，自幼遭该65岁官员性侵，在15岁左右怀孕。官员曾威胁其家人且再次性侵。9月18日艾的家人提供医学证据报警。官员到案后否认强奸指控，但承认曾与艾发生关系，声称系自愿且称其为妻子。官员曾扬言持枪，警方在讯问前搜查其是否携带武器。

title: 12 Thais back, 27 sent home
desc: SA KAEO: Authorities have received 12 Thais repatriated from Cambodia and sent home 27 Cambodians who had completed legal proceedings in Thailand.
title_cn: 泰柬边界遣返：12名泰国人返回，27名柬埔寨人被遣送回国
summary_cn: 沙缴（Sa Kaeo）边界当局完成了泰柬之间的人员互换遣返行动。当地接回12名泰国籍人士，同时将27名已完成泰国法律程序的柬埔寨人遣送回国。此举属于两国常规边境管理程序的一部分，体现了对非法越境事件和司法程序的规范处理。
desc_original: SA KAEO: Authorities have received 12 Thais repatriated from Cambodia and sent home 27 Cambodians who had completed legal proceedings in Thailand.

title: Five officers face probe after Chiang Mai gambling raids
desc: Police are preparing to investigate five Chiang Mai officers for negligence after administrative officials raided two long-running gambling dens in the city centre and detained more than 100 people.
title_cn: 清迈赌博突袭后5名警官面临调查
summary_cn: 清迈市中心两家长期经营的赌博场所近日遭行政部门突袭，逾百人被拘捕。警方已准备对5名清迈警官启动调查，指控他们在打击赌博活动中存在渎职行为。这起案件引发了对执法部门监督和问责机制的广泛关注。
desc_original: Police are preparing to investigate five Chiang Mai officers for negligence after administrative officials raided two long-running gambling dens in the city centre and detained more than 100 people.

title: Akanat unveils solar scheme
desc: Energy Minister Akanat Promphan has unveiled plans to reform Thailand's power structure by expanding household solar rooftop capacity to 10,000MW, allowing households to generate electricity for their own use and sell surplus power back to the grid.
title_cn: 能源部长公布家庭太阳能扩展方案
summary_cn: 能源部长阿卡纳特（Akanat Promphan）宣布了泰国电力结构改革计划。该方案将家庭太阳能屋顶装机容量扩充至1万兆瓦，鼓励住户自行发电自用，并允许余电并入电网出售。此举旨在实现能源多元化，缓解电网压力，同时为广大家庭增加收入来源。
desc_original: Energy Minister Akanat Promphan has unveiled plans to reform Thailand's power structure by expanding household solar rooftop capacity to 10,000MW, allowing households to generate electricity for their own use and sell surplus power back to the grid.

title: DRT tightens watch on longest rail tunnel
desc: The Department of Rail Transport (DRT) has stepped up inspections of the Den Chai–Chiang Rai–Chiang Khong line, now 70.6% complete, as work continues on Thailand's longest rail tunnel.
title_cn: 铁路部门加强泰国最长铁路隧道监督
summary_cn: 泰国铁路运输部（DRT）加强了对甘蔴（Den Chai）－清莱（Chiang Rai）－清孔（Chiang Khong）铁路线的监管检查。该工程为泰国最长铁路隧道所在的项目，目前完成度已达70.6%。铁路部门正加紧推进施工，预计将进一步完善泰国北部的铁路运输网络。
desc_original: The Department of Rail Transport (DRT) has stepped up inspections of the Den Chai–Chiang Rai–Chiang Khong line, now 70.6% complete, as work continues on Thailand's longest rail tunnel.

title: EC's shockwave upsets 'blue camp'
desc: The Election Commission (EC)'s decision to refer the Senate vote-rigging case, which involves 77 suspects, to the Supreme Court has put 26 serving senators from the so-called "blue camp" -- politicians linked to the ruling Bhumjaithai (BJT) Party -- at the centre of a legal process that could shift the balance of power in the upper house.
title_cn: 选举委员会决定引发「蓝营」震动
summary_cn: 选举委员会决定将涉及77名嫌疑人的参议院舞弊案转交最高法院。来自「蓝营」（与执政为泰党（Bhumjaithai）相关联的政治阵营）的26名现任参议员因此被卷入这场法律程序。此案的发展可能重塑参议院的权力格局，对泰国政治产生深远影响。
desc_original: The Election Commission (EC)'s decision to refer the Senate vote-rigging case, which involves 77 suspects, to the Supreme Court has put 26 serving senators from the so-called "blue camp" -- politicians linked to the ruling Bhumjaithai (BJT) Party -- at the centre of a legal process that could shift the balance of power in the upper house.

title: PM to show 'Thai potential' while overseas
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will embark on a three-nation tour to Japan, the United States, and the United Kingdom this week. The trip aims to showcase Thailand's economic potential, boost market confidence and attract foreign investment.
title_cn: 总理出访期间展示泰国潜力
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）本周对日本、美国和英国进行三国访问。此行旨在向国际社会展示泰国的经济发展潜力，增强国际投资者对泰国经济前景的信心，同时吸引更多外资进入泰国市场，推动经济增长和国际合作。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will embark on a three-nation tour to Japan, the United States, and the United Kingdom this week. The trip aims to showcase Thailand's economic potential, boost market confidence and attract foreign investment.

title: Dems demand review of frigate plan
desc: The Democrat Party on Saturday demanded the Defence Ministry revise its 17‑billion‑baht frigate procurement plan, citing potential corruption in the bidding process.
title_cn: 民主党要求重审护卫舰采购计划
summary_cn: 泰国民主党周六要求国防部重新审视170亿泰铢的护卫舰采购计划，声称竞标过程存在潜在腐败风险。民主党的举措旨在加强军事采购监督，防止公共资金挪作他用。该护卫舰采购项目因贪腐问题引发关注，民主党呼吁进行系统性的程序修订和监管加强。
desc_original: The Democrat Party on Saturday demanded the Defence Ministry revise its 17‑billion‑baht frigate procurement plan, citing potential corruption in the bidding process.

title: Speeding driver blamed for scaring wild elephants in Khao Yai
desc: Speeding driver blamed for scaring wild elephants in Khao Yai Legacy Wild elephant lovers criticised a driver online yesterday, September 19, after a car reportedly sped past a father and calf crossing a road in Khao Yai National Park. A political party leader is now urging the park chief to take disciplinary action against the man. The two wild elephants, Pho Ngathong and Tonkla, were walking across the road when the car came through, according to online posts. The startled calf ran to the roadside and nearly collided with its father. Online users asked what the elephants had done wrong and why the driver showed so little regard for them. Photo courtesy of Amarin TV Kanchana Silpa-archa, leader of the Chart Thai Pattana Party, also known as Nuna, addressed the incident on her Facebook page. She said the driver’s behaviour frightened Tonkla and nearly hit Pho Ngathong, and asked whether he would take responsibility had he hit the elephant in its own habitat. Kanchana said she understands the driver to be a retired park official, whom she described as a former assistant chief. She urged Chaiya, the chief of Khao Yai National Park, to deal with the man firmly. Kanchana claimed

title: 思蕊梵公主率代表团亮相亚运会开幕式，将亲自出战马术比赛
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，当地时间9月19日，第20届亚洲运动会开幕式在日本爱知县名古屋市瑞穗公园田径体育场隆重举行。泰国思蕊梵公主殿下抵达日本后，出席亚运会开幕式，并将以泰国国家马术队运动员身份，参加本届亚运会盛装舞步团体赛和个人赛。 思蕊梵公主于当天抵达名古屋后，首先前往设于亚运村内的泰国代表团总部，受到泰国奥委会副主席塔纳、泰国代表团负责人及相关官员迎接。 期间，思蕊梵公主视察了泰国代表团总部，了解代表团备战及后勤保障工作，并在纪念照片上签名留念。随后，公主殿下接见了泰国运动员及工作人员，与泰国国家女子排球队等运动员亲切合影、交流，勉励大家在比赛中发挥最佳水平，为国家争光。 随后，思蕊梵公主与泰国代表团一同乘车前往名古屋瑞穗公园田径体育场，并亲自率领泰国体育代表团步入开幕式会场。现场泰国运动员及工作人员深受鼓舞，气氛热烈。 本届亚运会开幕式上，泰国代表团由思蕊梵公主率队入场，泰国女排国手塔达奥和泰国国家马术队运动员差林昌共同担任旗手，高举泰国国旗，引领代表团入场。代表团身着由思蕊梵公主亲自设计的SIRIVANNAVARI品牌官方礼服亮相，展现了泰国文化特色与现代设计理念。 值得关注的是，思蕊梵公主不仅出席亚运会开幕式，还将代表泰国参加马术盛装舞步团体赛和个人赛，成为本届亚运会备受瞩目的王室运动员之一。 本届亚运会开幕式汇聚了亚洲各国和地区政要及体育界代表。日本天皇德仁、皇后雅子、皇嗣秋筱宫文仁亲王及纪子妃出席开幕式，亚洲奥林匹克理事会主席谢赫·乔安·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼以及国际奥林匹克委员会主席柯丝蒂·考文垂等嘉宾也出席了活动。 开幕式由日本著名导演堤幸彦担任总导演。日本男子组合INI率先献上暖场演出，随后大阪知名小提琴演奏家赤濑太郎登台演奏，日本著名演员兼声优户田惠子演唱日本国歌。来自亚洲45个国家和地区的代表团依次入场，日本奥运冠军室伏广治与其父亲、五届亚运会冠军室伏重信共同点燃主火炬，正式拉开第20届亚洲运动会帷幕。 据了解，本届亚运会共有来自46个国家和地区的1.1万余名运动员参赛，将在43个大项、71个分项中角逐469枚金牌。赛事将持续至10月4日。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：bangkokbiznews、thaipost） The post 思蕊梵公主率代表团亮相亚运会开幕式，将亲自出战马术比赛 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Hundreds of households hit by severe weather
desc: Flash floods hit communities in several provinces from North to South after heavy and prolonged rain caused rivers to overflow, with hundreds of households affected and authorities stepping up evacuation and disaster-response measures.
title_cn: 暴雨洪灾影响泰国数百家庭
summary_cn: 泰国多省因连日暴雨遭遇严重洪灾，河流决口导致从北到南多个社区受灾。数百个家庭房屋和生命财产受到严重威胁，当局已启动应急疏散和救灾措施。洪灾造成广泛影响，涉及生活供应、交通运输等多方面，政府全力推进灾后重建工作。
desc_original: Flash floods hit communities in several provinces from North to South after heavy and prolonged rain caused rivers to overflow, with hundreds of households affected and authorities stepping up evacuation and disaster-response measures.

title: PP head calls for new charter
desc: People's Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has marked the 20th anniversary of the Sept 19, 2006 coup by calling for a new constitution, citing more than 21 million votes earlier this year in favour of beginning the process.
title_cn: 人民党领导人呼吁制定新宪法
summary_cn: 人民党领导人纳塔邦·润潘亚武特以2006年9月19日政变20周年为契机，呼吁泰国制定新宪法。他指出今年早些时候有超过2100万选民投票赞成启动宪法制定程序，认为新宪法对泰国民主制度发展至关重要。这一呼声代表了部分政治力量对国家体制改革的期待。
desc_original: People's Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has marked the 20th anniversary of the Sept 19, 2006 coup by calling for a new constitution, citing more than 21 million votes earlier this year in favour of beginning the process.

Meanwhile the monsoon trough lies across the lower Central the upper South and the East regions with the rather strong southwest monsoon prevails over the Andaman Sea, the South and the Gulf with isolated heavy rains in the country. title: Trust remains elusive
desc: The main opposition People’s Party (PP) may be calling on Pheu Thai to abandon the Bhumjaithai-led coalition government, but rebuilding trust between the two parties could prove considerably harder than bringing them together against a common political adversary.
title_cn: 政治信任何时能重建
summary_cn: 主要反对党人民党 People's Party 呼吁执政党为泰党 Pheu Thai 退出由红布尔基党领导的联合政府。尽管两党有共同的政治对手可团结，但重建彼此间的信任难度不小，这可能成为政治重组和权力重配的重大障碍。

title: Huai Khwang raids find unlabelled goods and a possible Thai ID irregularity
desc: Huai Khwang raids find unlabelled goods and a possible Thai ID irregularity Legacy Huai Khwang police have seized more than 1,000 illegal goods from four premises in Bangkok, in the third phase of an ongoing operation to clean up the district. One store had told officials it deregistered over a year ago, yet was found still trading as normal. The raid took place on Wednesday, 17 September, and involved Huai Khwang police working alongside the Department of Business Development, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB). Photo courtesy of Amarin TV At a Chinese supermarket opposite Soi Pracharat Bamphen 7, officers found goods carrying no Thai labels and no FDA approval. An advertisement for an online gambling site was found hidden behind the counter. Business records showed the shop had deregistered more than a year earlier despite continuing to operate. A 50 year old Thai woman working at the store gave confused answers about her wages and employer, and her Thai was unclear despite her holding a Thai identity card. She was taken in for further questioning, and Huai Khwang police have asked the Department of Provincial Administra

title: 亚运不止看比赛！曼谷打造互动体育空间，呼吁全民参与体育热潮
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国国家体育局与国际体育发展基金联手Toyota、AIS、PTT、Counterpain、Sponsor、Yamaha、Grand Sport以及Samyan Mitrtown等合作伙伴，在曼谷 Samyan Mitrtown 以“#มากกว่ามหกรรมกีฬา ALL IN ASIAN GAMES”为主题，为民众打造集体育体验、娱乐互动与赛事观赛于一体的城市体育空间。 据悉，该活动于9月19日正式举行，活动现场邀请到泰籍国际艺人TEN（李永钦）以及泰国演员、前国家游泳运动员 Est Supha Sangaworawong 担任活动推广大使。两人在现场通过任天堂网球游戏展开趣味对决，与现场观众共同感受亚洲运动会带来的体育氛围。 此次活动由泰国国家体育局和国家体育发展基金提供支持，现场设置大型LED屏幕，免费直播第20届亚洲运动会赛事，为当地民众及年轻群体提供观看和为泰国运动员加油的公共空间。主办方希望通过体育互动与赛事观赛，进一步推动公众参与体育运动，让体育成为日常生活的一部分。 作为活动的重要环节，TEN与Est分享了自己对体育及亚洲运动会的感受。TEN表示，希望通过此次活动向亚洲各地的运动员和年轻人传递积极力量，鼓励大家勇于追逐自己的目标、突破极限。 曾代表泰国参加比赛的Est则表示，希望以新的身份继续传递体育精神，将“20th Asian Games Playground@Samyan Mitrtown”打造成为连接运动员与观众的互动空间，让更多人参与其中，为泰国代表队加油助威。 互动空间特别设置多个体育互动区域，包括壁网球、羽毛球、跑步以及拳击等。其中，壁网球区域提供特色网球拍互动体验；羽毛球区域结合任天堂游戏进行羽毛球挑战；跑步区域设置多种跑步模式；拳击区域则提供适合不同年龄层参与的拳击挑战。 公众可免费参与各项互动活动，也可以通过现场LED大屏观看亚洲运动会重点赛事，为泰国运动员加油。活动设置于Samyan Mitrtown购物中心G层半户外活动区域，开放时间为9月16日至25日；9月26日至10月4日则移至商场3层。 除体育互动项目外，活动现场还设有多个合作品牌展位，包括Toyota、AIS、PTT、Taisho、T.C. 、Yamaha及Grand Sport等。Samyan Mitrtown 运营方Frasers Property也参与其中，为到场体育爱好者提供相关互动体验。 据悉，第20届亚洲运动会赛事将于9月10日至10月4日举行，泰国观众可通过NBT、T Sports 7、9 MCOT HD、ONE 31、MONOMAX SPORTS TV、Thairath TV 32、PPTV HD 36以及AIS PLAY等平台观看赛事直播。AIS PLAY还将于10月16日至24日直播第5届亚洲残疾

title: Thai Navy picks Hanwha Ocean of South Korea for 16.73 billion baht frigate
desc: Thai Navy picks Hanwha Ocean of South Korea for 16.73 billion baht frigate Legacy Hanwha Ocean of South Korea has been selected to build a new frigate for the Royal Thai Navy, in a 16.73 billion baht (about US$496 million) deal the navy says was awarded through a transparent, rules based process. The result was announced on Friday, September 18, at an 11am press conference in the Chao Phraya Room at the navy auditorium. Navy commander-in-chief Admiral Pairoj Fueangchan gave the announcement. The project covers the frigate itself along with its onboard systems and equipment. Spare parts, documentation, logistical support, training and warranties are all included in the same budget. Rear Admiral Parat Rattanachaiphan, the navy’s spokesperson, set out the scope of the project. Its budget ceiling stands at 17 billion baht, or roughly US$504 million. The purchase falls under the navy’s long term force development plan, as laid out in its white paper. The new ship is intended to replace vessels due for retirement over the coming years. According to the navy, the frigate’s missions will include protecting sovereignty, shipping routes, economic zones and energy resources.

title: 泰国海关查获16.5吨中国走私猪肉
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国海关在清莱府湄赛口岸查获超过16.5吨从中国走私入境的冷冻猪肉。涉案人员将猪肉藏在货柜深处，其余位置堆放申报进口的新鲜蔬菜作为掩护，涉案货物估值约153万泰铢。 此次行动由清盛海关、湄赛海关及泰国海关第三区办公室联合展开。执法人员此前发现一批在湄赛海关办理通关手续的货柜存在异常。申报文件显示，货柜内仅装有甜菜根、青梗白菜和绿珊瑚生菜3种新鲜蔬菜，共930箱，净重超过18.8吨。 执法人员随后对货柜进行X光扫描和风险分析，发现内部存在密度及结构异常的可疑物品，而且实际重量与申报文件明显不符，随即联合清莱动物检疫站、清盛食品药品检查站及清盛植物检疫站进行开箱检查。 检查发现，货柜前部确实堆放着申报的新鲜蔬菜，但在货柜深处藏有大量冷冻猪肉，共379箱，净重16514.1公斤。相关猪肉均未进行海关申报，也没有检疫证明及进口许可。 目前，泰国海关已依法扣押全部涉案货物。相关行为涉嫌虚假申报、逃避进口限制，违反泰国《海关法》《动物传染病法》及《食品法》，案件将依法进一步处理。 泰国海关表示，将继续严厉打击非法进口肉类及农产品，防范未经检疫肉类可能带来的动物疫病及食品安全风险，遏制非法进口商品扰乱国内市场价格，以维护泰国消费者食品安全及本土养殖户利益。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：thenews、fm911） The post 泰国海关查获16.5吨中国走私猪肉 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thailand adds Legionnaires, SFTS, RSV and shingles to disease watch list
desc: Thailand adds Legionnaires, SFTS, RSV and shingles to disease watch list Legacy Thailand has added four more illnesses, Legionnaires’ disease, severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), RSV and shingles, to its list of notifiable diseases, meaning doctors and hospitals must now report every case to the Department of Disease Control. The national communicable disease committee approved the draft notification on Friday, September 18, during its fifth meeting of the year, held at the Department of Disease Control within the Ministry of Public Health. Public Health Minister Phatthana Phromphat chaired the meeting. Dr Monthian Khanasawat of the Department of Disease Control also attended, along with representatives from other agencies. Placing an illness on the notifiable list requires clinicians to report every case they see. The Department of Disease Control uses this reporting to track how far and how quickly a disease is spreading. The committee also reviewed a separate draft covering Thailand’s national immunisation programme. If approved, the measure would give the programme a formal legal footing and link vaccine records currently held across different parts

title: Russian rider goes to help the other motorcyclist as his own Ducati burns
desc: Russian rider goes to help the other motorcyclist as his own Ducati burns Legacy A Russian motorcyclist has been praised for stopping to check on an injured Thai rider even as his own motorcycle burned nearby after a crash near Pattaya . The collision happened on the evening of Wednesday, September 17, on Route 36 near the Wat Santikham U-turn in Nong Pla Lai, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri. Rescue workers from the Sawang Boriboon Thammasathan Foundation were called to the Pattaya-bound side of the road. They found a red Ducati lying on its side and showing fire damage. Its rider, a 24 year old Russian man, had grazes across his body. A Honda Wave was found nearby with damage of its own. Its rider, named by police as Thanakrit, a 39 year old Thai man, was also hurt. Witnesses told rescue workers that the Ducati had been travelling straight in the right lane when the Honda Wave moved across from the left lane into its path. The two motorcycles collided, and the Ducati then caught fire. Despite his own injuries, the Russian man ran to check on Thanakrit rather than wait for help, witnesses said. Both men were treated at the scene before being taken to Pattaya Patthamakhun Hospital. Bang Lamu
title_cn: 俄罗斯骑手不顾爱车着火，勇救肇事对方
summary_cn: 芭提雅发生摩托车碰撞事故，一名24岁俄罗斯骑手驾驶的杜卡迪（Ducati）跑车与泰国39岁骑手的本田Wave相撞后起火。尽管自己全身擦伤，这名俄罗斯骑手仍冒危险跑去检查并帮助受伤的泰国骑手，而不是等待救援到达。两名伤者在现场接受救治后送往芭提雅帕塔玛坤医院。其勇敢无私的举动受到广泛赞誉。
desc_original: Russian rider goes to help the other motorcyclist as his own Ducati burns Legacy A Russian motorcyclist has been praised for stopping to check on an injured Thai rider even as his own motorcycle burned nearby after a crash near Pattaya . The collision happened on the evening of Wednesday, September 17, on Route 36 near the Wat Santikham U-turn in Nong Pla Lai, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri. Rescue workers from the Sawang Boriboon Thammasathan Foundation were called to the Pattaya-bound side of the road. They found a red Ducati lying on its side and showing fire damage. Its rider, a 24 year old Russian man, had grazes across his body. A Honda Wave was found nearby with damage of its own. Its rider, named by police as Thanakrit, a 39 year old Thai man, was also hurt. Witnesses told rescue workers that the Ducati had been travelling straight in the right lane when the Honda Wave moved across from the left lane into its path. The two motorcycles collided, and the Ducati then caught fire. Despite his own injuries, the Russian man ran to check on Thanakrit rather than wait for help, witnesses said. Both men were treated at the scene before being taken to Pattaya Patthamakhun Hospital. Bang Lamu

title: 泰国突查罗勇府亿级项目，逮捕14名无证外劳
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月18日，泰国劳工部部长朱拉潘指派工作小组，联合特别案件调查厅（DSI）前往罗勇府，对一外资企业工厂建设项目的外劳用工情况进行检查。据悉，这一项目投资额超过10亿泰铢，占地面积达200多莱，是该企业继在春武里府首次投资后建造的第二座工厂。 在现场检查外籍劳工的用工情况和工作证件时，执法人员发现，该工地的作业分为两个部分：一是办公区，共60多名员工，其中中国籍员工50余人，而泰国籍员工仅有8人；二是施工区，共200多名工人，绝大多数为中国籍和缅甸籍外劳，泰国工人仅有6人，且主要从事现场协调工作。另外，该项目的施工主管人员据称均为中国籍。 然而，检查期间却有一些工人试图离开现场，执法人员上前拦截并控制了部分人员。经初步核查，这84名工人中，有6名中国籍人员和8名缅甸籍人员无法出示合法的工作许可证，目前已被依法拘留以接受后续处理。 劳工部部长秘书素拉查表示，还有些工人从项目后方乘坐车辆逃离，其中包括从事现场管理或“包工头”职务的中国籍人员，他已指示执法人员跟踪核查，并要求涉事公司带相关人员到案说明情况和提交证明文件。如果证件齐全且操作合规，就没有问题，但如果有违法行为，则将依法公正处理。执法的目的不是阻碍外商投资，泰国一直欢迎投资者，但投资和招工都必须遵守泰国的法律，保障泰国工人的就业机会和合法权益。 劳工部发言人皮帕猜指出，从现场的劳工比例来看，政府部门有必要进行严肃审查，尤其是关于泰国工人的聘用和外劳的引入，以及外劳实际从事的岗位是否符合相关规定和法律条件等。外商投资应为泰国的经济和就业带来效益，当一个大型工地几乎没有泰国工人，而管理人员又多为外籍人员时，就有必要查清其用工结构，以及每一个环节是否合规。 除此之外，执法人员还掌握了某分包商的相关信息，其于此前将多名主管人员及工人带入项目现场作业。由于该公司的注册状态存在疑点，相关部门正在进一步核实事实，并调查经营者与商业运作模式之间的关联。 接下来，就业办将就泰国工人与外籍劳工的聘用比例、工作许可证和实际从事的工作性质展开深入排查，DSI则将对项目业主公司、主包商和分包商的相关资料进行核查，以确定其是否违规经营，以及是否存在将泰国作为投资基地、而经济效益和用工收益全部回流的“零元”经营行为，并依法采取后续处理。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 泰国突查罗勇府亿级项目，逮捕14名无证外劳 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: iPhone 18泰国首发火爆，门店大排长龙
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月18日，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max在泰国正式开售，位于ICONSIAM的泰国首家Apple Store从一大早开始就十分热闹，提前预订iPhone 18的顾客排起长队等着领取新机，现场全是想第一时间拿到最新款手机的果粉。据悉，泰国与美国一样，都属于新款iPhone第一批上市的国家和地区，已于9月12日起开放预购。 上午，在Apple Store ICONSIAM正式营业前，店门口就挤满了顾客，提前下单的人满脸期待。Apple Store的工作人员也按照全球其他门店的传统，热情地接待第一批顾客，为首发日增添了不少气氛。大家对Apple这款新产品兴趣很高，尤其是那些想第一天就拿到手机、亲身体验新品的人。 （编译：KA；来源：thebangkokinsight、Matichon） The post iPhone 18泰国首发火爆，门店大排长龙 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

summary_cn: 气象部发布第9号公报，警告泰国南部部分地区将出现大暴雨，防洪措施启动。受影响地区需加强防范，海上小船禁止驶离安达曼海沿岸至9月20日。同时，曼谷及周边地区有80%降雨概率。气象部提醒居民做好防灾准备。
desc_original: ประกาศอุตุฯ ฉบับ 9 เตือนภาคใต้ฝนตกหนักมากบางพื้นที่ พื้นที่เสี่ยงระวังน้ำท่วม เรือเล็กงดออกฝั่งอันดามันจนถึงวันที่ 20 ก.ย. นี้ กรุงเทพและปริมณฑล มีฝนฟ้าคะนอง 80%

title: Bangchak to replace chief executive in 2027
desc: Chaiwat Kovavisarach plans to step down as chief executive of Bangchak Corporation at the end of this year, bringing to a close more than a decade of leadership that transformed the company from a financially struggling oil refiner into one of Thailand's largest and most diversified energy groups.
title_cn: 邦恰克集团换帅 首席执行官年底卸任
summary_cn: 邦恰克集团首席执行官柴瓦特·科瓦维萨拉克计划在2026年底辞任，结束他十多年的领导生涯。他领导期间成功将该公司从财务困难的炼油企业转型为泰国最大、最多元化的能源集团之一。此次高层更换将标志着公司发展的一个重要转折点。
desc_original: Chaiwat Kovavisarach plans to step down as chief executive of Bangchak Corporation at the end of this year, bringing to a close more than a decade of leadership that transformed the company from a financially struggling oil refiner into one of Thailand's largest and most diversified energy groups.

title: Anutin preps coalition for censure test
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said he was in contact with coalition leaders and ministers and was preparing another dinner meeting to strengthen ties ahead of the upcoming censure debate.
title_cn: 阿努廷备战弹劾 联合政府强化团结
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·查尔维拉古尔表示正与联盟伙伴保持紧密联系，并计划召开联合晚宴会议，旨在加强政治联盟的团结与凝聚力，为即将进行的弹劾辩论做足准备。政府在政治挑战前展开积极的团结部署。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said he was in contact with coalition leaders and ministers and was preparing another dinner meeting to strengthen ties ahead of the upcoming censure debate.

title: Recipients may get 1,000-baht boost
desc: The government has indicated that the second phase of the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme is likely to provide a one-off 1,000-baht allowance, which can be used over two months.
title_cn: 「泰国人帮助泰国人Plus」第二阶段 补助1000铢
summary_cn: 政府表示共付计划的第二阶段预计向受益人提供一次性1000铢补助，可在两个月期间内灵活使用。这是政府继续推进社会救济措施的重要举措，旨在为低收入群体提供实质经济支持，缓解生活压力。
desc_original: The government has indicated that the second phase of the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme is likely to provide a one-off 1,000-baht allowance, which can be used over two months.

title: Navy stands by frigate bidding
desc: The Royal Thai Navy has come under public scrutiny after only one company, South Korea's Hanwha Ocean, was deemed qualified to take on the 17-billion-baht frigate procurement.
title_cn: 护卫舰采购独家中标 海军招标引发质疑
summary_cn: 泰国皇家海军170亿铢护卫舰采购项目在资格评审中引发争议。仅有韩国韩华海洋公司通过资格审查，其他投标企业均被排除。此事引发公众对采购过程透明度和市场竞争性的广泛质疑。
desc_original: The Royal Thai Navy has come under public scrutiny after only one company, South Korea's Hanwha Ocean, was deemed qualified to take on the 17-billion-baht frigate procurement.

title: iPhone 18 launch sparks upgrade rush
desc: The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max series drew a stronger consumer response than forecast on the first day of sales in Thailand on Friday, as replacement demand supported purchases, while retailers and mobile operators competed to offer trade-in schemes, extended financing and future buyback offers.
title_cn: iPhone 18发布引发换机热潮
summary_cn: iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max系列在泰国首日销售表现超预期，消费者替换需求旺盛。零售商和移动运营商纷纷推出以旧换新、分期付款和未来回购等优惠方案竞争市场。
desc_original: The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max series drew a stronger consumer response than forecast on the first day of sales in Thailand on Friday, as replacement demand supported purchases, while retailers and mobile operators competed to offer trade-in schemes, extended financing and future buyback offers.

title: AirAsia denies state bailout rumours
desc: AirAsia has dismissed rumours of a Malaysian government bailout and possible collapse, saying its refinancing remains on track, while Thai AirAsia expects to maintain its position as the largest player in the domestic market.
title_cn: 亚航否认政府救助传闻
summary_cn: 亚航澄清否认马来西亚政府救助传言及可能倒闭的说法，声称融资重组工作按计划进行。泰国亚航预期继续维持国内航空市场最大运营商的地位。
desc_original: AirAsia has dismissed rumours of a Malaysian government bailout and possible collapse, saying its refinancing remains on track, while Thai AirAsia expects to maintain its position as the largest player in the domestic market.

title: Thailand's liberal gold regime at risk
desc: Investment in gold has long been regarded as a hedge against economic uncertainty, particularly during periods of heightened volatility. Yet gold is increasingly being used as a means of converting grey money into legitimate money, raising concerns about its broader impact on the country's economy and society.
title_cn: 泰国宽松黄金政策面临风险
summary_cn: 黄金投资长期被视为对冲经济不确定性的工具，但近年黄金交易日益成为灰色资金合法化的手段，引发外界对泰国经济和社会的广泛担忧。相关政策调整可能在即。
desc_original: Investment in gold has long been regarded as a hedge against economic uncertainty, particularly during periods of heightened volatility. Yet gold is increasingly being used as a means of converting grey money into legitimate money, raising concerns about its broader impact on the country's economy and society.

title: Commission to beef up digital platform regulations
desc: The Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) plans to strengthen regulations to address unfair competition in the digital platform industry.
title_cn: 竞争委员会加强数字平台监管
summary_cn: 泰国贸易竞争委员会（TCCT）计划强化对数字平台行业的监管力度，以应对和遏制不公平竞争行为，规范市场秩序。
desc_original: The Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) plans to strengthen regulations to address unfair competition in the digital platform industry.

title: Thailand pauses data-centre approvals while it writes new minimum standards
desc: Thailand pauses data-centre approvals while it writes new minimum standards Legacy Thailand has temporarily stopped approving and building data centres while it rewrites the rules for the industry. The pause covers projects already under way and those waiting for a decision. Deputy Prime Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas says projects already under way and those awaiting a decision are both on hold. Agencies have one month to set minimum standards. The national data-centre policy committee agreed the measure at a meeting on September 4. Ekniti Nitithanprapas, who is deputy prime minister and finance minister, announced it afterwards. Investors have until now dealt with each ministry and agency separately, he said. The country had never organised the industry as a whole. Ekniti said Thailand was not trying to block or turn away foreign money. The change is from approving projects agency by agency to setting a single national strategy. Agencies have a month to write minimum standards on economic, social and environmental grounds. Those will apply to sites already running, to sites being built, and to anything proposed later. title: Dental clinic warning issued
desc: The Department of Health Service Support has urged patients to verify dental clinics and practitioners before seeking treatment, following the arrest of a woman accused of running an unlicensed dental service from her home in Ayutthaya.
title_cn: 牙科诊所警告声明
summary_cn: 泰国卫生服务支持部门发出警告，要求患者就诊前核实牙科诊所和医生资格。大城府阿育他亚一名女性因经营无执照家庭牙科服务被捕，引发该提醒。患者应提高警觉，避免非正规医疗服务风险。
desc_original: The Department of Health Service Support has urged patients to verify dental clinics and practitioners before seeking treatment, following the arrest of a woman accused of running an unlicensed dental service from her home in Ayutthaya.

title: Rate worries keep Thai shares in check
desc: Thai shares retreated this week amid volatile trade in global equities prior to key central banks' policy meetings, particularly the US Federal Reserve.
title_cn: 利率担忧压低泰国股市
summary_cn: 受全球金融市场波动影响，泰国股市本周下跌。投资者关注美国联邦储备委员会（Federal Reserve）等全球主要央行即将召开的政策会议，担心利率政策调整对市场的冲击。全球股票交易保持高度波动。
desc_original: Thai shares retreated this week amid volatile trade in global equities prior to key central banks' policy meetings, particularly the US Federal Reserve.

title: Small firms eye wider stimulus scheme
desc: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) have called on the government to expand the eligibility criteria for shops participating in the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme, raising the annual revenue ceiling from the current 1.8 million baht to 5 million baht.
title_cn: 中小企业争取更广泛的刺激方案
summary_cn: 泰国中小型企业呼吁政府扩大「泰人帮助泰人增强版」刺激方案的参与资格。他们要求将商家年收入门槛从现有的180万泰铢提升至500万泰铢，以惠及更多小微企业，扩大政策覆盖面。
desc_original: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) have called on the government to expand the eligibility criteria for shops participating in the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme, raising the annual revenue ceiling from the current 1.8 million baht to 5 million baht.

title: Bond yields escalate  funding costs for businesses
desc: Business operators face higher financing costs as bond yields rise, despite the Bank of Thailand's policy rate being the second-lowest among central banks worldwide.
title_cn: 债券收益率飙升加重企业融资负担
summary_cn: 债券收益率上升正在推高企业融资成本。尽管泰国央行的基准利率在全球央行中处于倒数第二低的水平，但企业仍面临更高的融资压力。反映了本地金融市场流动性和融资成本环境的变化。
desc_original: Business operators face higher financing costs as bond yields rise, despite the Bank of Thailand's policy rate being the second-lowest among central banks worldwide.

title: Stocks gain but oil-driven inflation still a worry
desc: RECAP: Asian stocks rose yesterday, helped by a dip in oil prices, even as investors grappled with efforts by global central ‌banks to rein in oil-driven inflation, with Japan hiking its benchmark interest rate.
title_cn: 股市回升 油价通胀隐忧犹存
summary_cn: 亚洲股市昨日上涨，受油价回落提振。但投资者仍在关注全球央行应对油价驱动通胀的举措，日本央行近日上调基准利率。油价因素对通胀的压力仍是市场的长期关切。
desc_original: RECAP: Asian stocks rose yesterday, helped by a dip in oil prices, even as investors grappled with efforts by global central ‌banks to rein in oil-driven inflation, with Japan hiking its benchmark interest rate.

title: SEC tightens net  on scam networks
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is stepping up enforcement against scam networks and cross-border money laundering, with assets frozen immediately in cases where there is sufficient evidence, while complex securities cases may require more time to trace the ultimate owners of the assets.
title_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会加强打击诈骗网络
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）加大力度打击诈骗网络和跨境洗钱活动。委员会在掌握充分证据的情况下立即冻结相关资产，复杂证券案件需要更多时间追溯资产最终所有者。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is stepping up enforcement against scam networks and cross-border money laundering, with assets frozen immediately in cases where there is sufficient evidence, while complex securities cases may require more time to trace the ultimate owners of the assets.

title: British YouTuber reveals cost of living in Pattaya at just £600 a month
desc: British YouTuber reveals cost of living in Pattaya at just £600 a month Legacy A British YouTuber who runs a bar in Pattaya says his rent and household bills come to just over £600 (about 26,000 baht) a month, a fraction of what he would pay at home in the West Midlands. Macauley Haycock, 31, left Wolverhampton three years ago after saving for five years to fund the move. He now runs a bar in the resort city with his girlfriend and documents his life in Thailand for more than 90,000 subscribers on his YouTube channel, MacTV . Speaking to BirminghamLive , he said he had recently moved out of a condominium that cost about £360 (15,500 baht) a month and came with a gym and a 29th-floor swimming pool, into a three-bedroom house for about £580 (25,000 baht). His internet, water and electricity add roughly £25 (1,100 baht), he said. Food is his other main outlay. He said a month’s shopping had just cost him around £131 (5,600 baht), covering steak, chicken, tuna, cottage cheese, fruit and vegetables, drinks and a full set of spices. title: Elderly couple in Buri Ram die hours apart after decades together
desc: A story of enduring love between an elderly couple in Buri Ram has moved many people who read online how the pair, married for decades, died within hours of each other.
title_cn: 武里南老年夫妇相隔数小时先后离世
summary_cn: 武里南府 Buri Ram 一对婚姻长达数十年的老年夫妇以最感人的方式诠释了「白头偕老」之意。这对伉俪在相隔数小时内相继去世的故事在网络传播后引发众多网友感慨，体现了深厚的婚姻羁绊。
desc_original: A story of enduring love between an elderly couple in Buri Ram has moved many people who read online how the pair, married for decades, died within hours of each other.

title: Thailand at heart of Miss Universe turmoil
desc: Miss Universe Thailand and five of her Southeast Asian peers could be barred from competing in the Miss Universe 2026 pageant in November because of a bitter legal dispute over national franchise agreements.
title_cn: 泰国选美皇后陷环球小姐风波
summary_cn: 泰国小姐及五位东南亚选手因国家特许经营权的法律纠纷，可能被禁止参加2026年11月举办的环球小姐 Miss Universe 选美大赛。这场跨境争议引发关于国际选美赛事治理和地区代表权的热议。
desc_original: Miss Universe Thailand and five of her Southeast Asian peers could be barred from competing in the Miss Universe 2026 pageant in November because of a bitter legal dispute over national franchise agreements.

title: Fitch upgrades Thailand outlook to ‘stable’
desc: Fitch Ratings has revised Thailand’s outlook to “stable” ​from “negative”, ‌citing increased confidence that government debt will broadly stabilise over the medium term and that political conditions will improve following the general elections ​held ⁠earlier this year.
title_cn: 标普将泰国评级前景升级至「稳定」

title: 涉东南亚诈骗网络名单牵出泰国前高官！阿努廷：不顾忌谁，一切依法处理
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 美国国会众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·马斯特当地时间9月15日致函美国政府，要求对28个被指与东南亚诈骗网络存在关联的个人和实体展开调查，并评估是否实施制裁。名单中包括泰国前财政部副部长瓦拉帕·坦亚翁（Vorapak Tanyawong）。泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷当地时间9月18日12时35分在总理府接受采访时就此回应称，相关事项将依法处理。 阿努廷表示，一切都将依法处理。他强调，本届政府正在大力打击诈骗犯罪。每当外国代表来访，或泰方与各国安全机构会面、展开磋商前，对方都会向泰国政府在打击跨国科技犯罪、推动刑事追诉以及查封、没收犯罪资产等方面所做的工作表示感谢。 阿努廷指出，目前泰国警方仍在持续办理多起相关案件，并继续追查及查封涉案人员的资产。此外，泰国反洗钱办公室秘书长也曾向他汇报，目前查扣的一部分资产为股票，且相关股票市值已经上涨。有关部门正就如何依法处置这些资产与法院进行协商，包括能否将其没收并转为国有资产，或通过公开拍卖出售，从而将所得资金收归国库。 当被问及，尽管政府已经全面推进打击行动，但泰国人民党名单制议员朗西曼仍质疑总理究竟“顾忌谁”，为何没有真正严肃处理这一问题时，阿努廷笑着回应：“可以确定的是，我不顾忌谁，也不顾忌朗西曼。” 据了解，马斯特在信中分别向美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥和财政部长斯科特·贝森特提出上述请求，同时抄送美国司法部长及国土安全部长。信件要求美国政府在180天内作出评估，确认名单中的个人和实体是否符合美国相关制裁法律标准。信件称，对符合制裁条件的对象采取行动，将有助于遏制网络诈骗、人口贩运，以及为诈骗产业链提供政治和金融支持的相关活动。 瓦拉帕曾在泰国银行及金融行业担任高级管理职务，此次被列入美国要求调查并考虑制裁的东南亚诈骗网络相关名单。需要特别指出的是，被列入名单仅意味着美国国会议员要求政府展开调查并评估是否实施制裁，并不代表美国政府已经认定其实施了违法犯罪行为。 9月15日的信件共列出26名个人和2个商业实体，具体如下： Benjamin Mauerberger Chou Bun Eng，柬埔寨国家人口贩运问题委员会常务副主席 Deng Pibing Dy Vichea，柬埔寨国家警察副总监、洪森女婿 Edward Lee Eugene Tang Gabriel Tan Honn Sorachna Hun To，柬埔寨商人、洪森侄子 Kuoch Chamrouen，干丹省省长，曾任西哈努克省省长 Li Xiong Long Dimanche，西哈努克省副省长 Ma Dongli Michael Chiam Mote Thun Neth Savoeun，柬埔寨副总理、前国家警察总监 Sar Sokha，柬埔寨内政部长 Su Zhongkian Vorapak Tanyawong，泰国前银行及金融业高级管

title: American child sex offence suspect returned to Alabama after Phuket arrest
desc: American child sex offence suspect returned to Alabama after Phuket arrest Legacy American suspect Lance Michael Beck , arrested in Phuket last month over serious child sex offence allegations, has been returned to Alabama and is now being held without bail , US officials announced yesterday, September 17. Thai police arrested Beck in Phuket on August 29 after US authorities sought assistance locating him. He was detained ahead of his return to the United States, where the case has now moved into the American judicial process. Photo via abc3340 US authorities said Beck faces five charges in St. Clair County involving a child under 12: first-degree rape, first-degree sodomy, sexual torture, facilitating the travel of a child for a sexual purpose and human trafficking . Officials said that after learning Beck had fled to Thailand, US officials obtained a federal warrant for Unlawful Flight to Avoid Prosecution and coordinated with Thai law enforcement to locate him. title: Lisa’s overseas drinking segment did not breach advertising law
desc: Lisa’s overseas drinking segment did not breach advertising law Legacy Thailand’s public health minister has dismissed controversy surrounding Lisa’s appearance with a Thai alcoholic drink on an overseas television programme, saying the incident did not violate Thailand’s alcohol advertising law . Pattana Promphat said the segment was filmed and broadcast abroad, while Lisa’s actions appeared personal and showed no intention to advertise the product. “Thai law does not prohibit drinking alcohol. It prohibits alcohol advertising,” the minister explained. Lisa recently appeared on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon , where she introduced the host to som tam and a drink made with Thai beer, soju and Sprite. She also taught Fallon to say “mod kaew”, meaning “bottoms up”, before they drank together. Pattana said Thai media outlets and social media users who reshared the footage had generally blurred the brand name and logo, which he considered compliant with Thai law. However, he warned content creators to be careful when recreating the drink. desc_original: Lisa’s overseas drinking segment did not breach advertising law Legacy Thailand’s public health minister has dismissed controversy surrounding Lisa’s appearance with a Thai alcoholic drink on an overseas television programme, saying the incident did not violate Thailand’s alcohol advertising law . title: Deaf passenger praises Thai Airways crew’s clever menu
desc: Deaf passenger praises Thai Airways crew’s clever menu Legacy A deaf passenger has praised Thai Airways cabin crew after attendants reportedly drew pictures of the available meal choices to make it easier for him to order during a flight to Bangkok. Jose Irish Pascual shared the experience on Facebook, saying it was the first time he had encountered such an approach while travelling and praising the crew for finding a simple way to communicate with him. A social media post from Pascual’s account said he was travelling from Manila to Bangkok when crew members drew the meal options and placed the illustrations beside his seat, allowing him to choose without relying on spoken communication. Pascual said he initially felt slightly embarrassed by the attention but was impressed by the crew’s creativity and how easily the system allowed him, as a deaf passenger, to understand his choices. He described the approach as an example of the crew choosing to “work smart, not hard” when communicating with him.
